org.luaj.vm2.ErrorsTest.testBaseLibArgs.details: Error wording/case (String vs string), load/reader argument errors and native diagnostic conventions differ. Full transcript comparison is unsuitable for deciding semantic equivalence.

org.luaj.vm2.ErrorsTest.testDebugLibArgs.details: Function-form getlocal unsupported; Java frame with null stack can throw NPE; info/locals/hook API and messages differ from C; upvalue identities are process-specific.

org.luaj.vm2.ErrorsTest.testIoLibArgs.details: io.lines(nil) prints function: lnext rather than a native function address. This case is diagnostic representation only in the captured full diff.

org.luaj.vm2.ErrorsTest.testMathLibArgs.details: atan2 accepts a missing second argument (JSE default 1); min/max accept single non-number and fail mixed numeric strings; additional error wording differences.

org.luaj.vm2.ErrorsTest.testStringLibArg.details: Native string.dump header uses 8-byte size_t vs LuaJ 4-byte; compiler/upvalue metadata and binary rendering differ. %s coercion and negative gsub limit expectations also differ; LuaJC dump is covered separately.

base_load_xpcall.action: Keep in regression baseline; correct reader EOF and handler scope as separate semantic changes.
base_load_xpcall.cause: StringInputStream skips empty reader chunks; nested pcall invokes outer xpcall handler even when the inner error is caught. Both add lines absent from the fixture.

coroutine_oracle.action: Keep supported LuaJ coroutine behavior; replace C-runtime transcript with semantic assertions.
coroutine_oracle.cause: Fixture expects yield across metamethod/C-call boundary to fail; LuaJ supports yield through pcall and Java coroutine threads. Actual resume sequence succeeds.

debug_runtime_model.action: Add targeted assertions for invalid locals and hook balance; do not rewrite all C debug transcript as passing.
debug_runtime_model.cause: DebugLib.getLocal can return a live register value with nil local name; Java call frames/hooks differ from C stack frames, producing different hook order and line reports.

error_argument_transcripts.action: Split semantic argument-validation assertions from diagnostic-text/native-output comparisons.
error_argument_transcripts.cause: Per-case details are recorded under details; these are not all harmless error-message differences.

finite_number_format.action: Separate numeric formatting compatibility change; cover finite range, precision, NaN/infinities.
finite_number_format.cause: LuaDouble.tojstring narrows finite double to float. Fibonacci 199 is finite near 1.734e41 but printed as Infinity. This is a formatting failure, not failed upvalue arithmetic.

integer_fmod_zero.cause: MathLib.fmod uses Java long remainder when both values are islong; divisor 0 throws ArithmeticException before floating-point fallback.

jme_api_stub.action: Keep in historical JME audit; require emulator for actual JME IO validation, separate from JSE release gate.
jme_api_stub.cause: CLDC API dependency is a compile-time stub. javax.microedition.io.Connector.open throws java.lang.Error in JmeIoLib.openFile; oslib test also opens files.

math_numeric_coercion.action: Fix type/coercion independently; preserve diagnostic baseline until reviewed.
math_numeric_coercion.cause: modf returns the original numeric LuaString in islong fast path; min/max compare LuaValues without numeric coercion. Also includes integer fmod zero errors.

string_boundary_dump.action: Assert byte semantics separately from Java decoding; preserve LuaJC dump limitation and test it explicitly.
string_boundary_dump.cause: Invalid UTF-8 bytes pass through LuaString.tojstring/custom decoder, unlike native byte-output fixture. Numeric byte rows agree. LuaJC additionally cannot string.dump a Java-compiled function.

table_insert_fixture.action: Make invalid insert a pcall/assertion and retain later concat/remove/unpack tests; do not weaken LuaTable.insert.
table_insert_fixture.cause: tablelib.lua line 22 inserts at position 10 when #t+1 is 8. LuaJ rejects it; Lua 5.2.4 official tinsert also checks bounds. Fixture expects older permissive behavior and aborts subsequent tests.

timezone_fixture.action: Use explicit timezone or assertions independent of host timezone; production default timezone stays unchanged.
timezone_fixture.cause: oslib.out hardcodes America/Los_Angeles local time/DST. Asia/Tokyo differs by 16 hours at fixture dates. Both tests pass with America/Los_Angeles.

weak_integer_routing.action: Separate correctness fix with weak-value wrap/GC tests; do not ship the routing-only experiment.
weak_integer_routing.cause: LuaTable.hashset rehash(-1) can expand the array past a new integer key but still insert that key into hash; rawget reads the empty array slot. Key 3 disappears after the third insertion.
evidence: tools/run-causal-checks.sh: 20/20 sequence tests pass in isolated overlay

weak_storage_layout_assertion.action: Replace physical-capacity assertion with lookup/count assertions and retain full weak GC tests.
weak_storage_layout_assertion.cause: WeakValueTableTest.testWeakValuesTable assumes array capacity >=1. Current weak-value policy can store key 1 in hash; Lua does not expose this capacity. Test aborts before subsequent semantic/GC assertions.
